title: vriesea unilateralis
intro: Vriesea unilateralis, commonly known as the "Red Vriesea," is a species of flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae. It is a type of air plant that grows epiphytically, obtaining moisture and nutrients from the air and rain rather than through a root system. The health benefits of Vriesea unilateralis include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
